programme.title: 因 AI 相约 / AI Romance Episode 11
programme.desc: 由袁成杰、余有矿主持，心理咨询师于志凌坐镇的《因AI相约》，是中国首创全新相亲综艺。让AI红娘登场，牵起缘分的红线，用AI独家大数据模型，精准捕捉嘉宾个性，再用AI面具盲选，真诚交流点燃心动瞬间。到底是选择AI推荐，还是倾听内心声音？《因AI相约》用算法助力情缘，让爱情见证最美的邂逅！ “AI Romance” is a dating variety with a spin, marrying scientific AI technology with age-old romance and love! This is China’s first attempt at artificial intelligence experimental dating series and the programme brings on a whole new viewing experience and refreshed feel, for traditional dating varieties.

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶 / The Brave Yong Su Jeong Episode 124
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 10
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 26
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

徐冬熙梦想成为服装设计师，一场突如其来的意外，却让她必须领养侄子成为了单亲妈妈，多亏家人及邻居协助，让她在照顾侄子之余仍得以重拾曾经放弃的梦想。姜次烈则年幼时父亲去世，其后被叔叔收养，虽曾有彷徨时期，但他头脑聪明、成绩和外貌出众，可是他做的越好，哥哥和妈妈的表情就越冷淡。为了迎合母亲的喜好，次烈无法凭自己的意愿生活，虽然不想继承家族企业却被安排进入公司工作，虽不开心但也只能等着离开这个家独立的日子…
Seo Dong-Hee comes from a poor family background but despite this, she has a bright and positive personality. She dreams of becoming a designer and slowly works her way to achieve her dream. A family accident resulted in her becoming the mother of her nephew and she decides to raise him by h...

programme.title: 大泼猴 / The Legends Of Monkey King Episode 18
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 淮水竹亭 / Love in Pavilion Episode 36
programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 26
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 10
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 嗨放派 3 / Have Fun Season 3 Episode 10
programme.desc: 《嗨放派》是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，第三季主打真实的生存实验，六位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷、自制淋浴间、起火烧饭、自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头。 “Have Fun” returns for a third season! The very well-received China variety again sees six popular male artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 美女与纯情男 / Beauty and Mr Romantic Episode 3
programme.desc: 著名女演员朴道萝个性独特，她之所以成为演员，是因为母亲告诉她，这是脱离贫穷的唯一方法。透过成名而得到人气和金钱，道萝心底却希望可以休息，可是母亲却一直闯祸、挥霍生活，还贪图更多。母亲的欲望令道萝开始承受不了繁忙的工作，打算放弃参与新剧。就在这时，她遇上了初恋高必胜，也就是新剧的副导演。必胜对于工作充满热情，但因为道萝而决定放弃新剧。一次意外让道萝掉进必胜怀里，两人的人生从此再次连上。Top actress Park Do Ra rose to fame at her mother Baek Mi Ja's urge to escape poverty. programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。

programme.desc: 该剧根据尾鱼的同名小说改编。讲述了“沙漠玫瑰”叶流西与“智勇沙獠”昌东，一个为了解开身世之谜，一个为破解过往真相，两人联手深入奇幻世界探险的故事。

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 27
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 11
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 西出玉门 / Parallel World Episode 4

programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 12
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 28
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴 / The Legends Of Monkey King Episode 20
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 天地剑心 / Sword and Beloved Episode 2
programme.desc: 王权富贵是王权弘业和东方淮竹的儿子，是王权世家实力最强者。被家族作为道门兵人培养的王权富贵，生活没有自由，而清瞳本来是毒娘子安排到王权家打听情报的间谍，和王权富贵结识后，在富贵的帮助下恢复了自由。同时王权富贵内心渴望自由、憧憬天下大同的信念亦被逐渐点燃，经历万剑穿心，王权富贵带着清瞳离开王权山庄，走上了自己所悟之道。Wang Quan Fu Gui is the son of Wang Quan Hong Ye and Dongfang Huai Zhu, and the most powerful member of the Wang Quan family. Trained as a Daoist soldier, Fu Gui lived a life without freedom. Qing Tong, initially a spy planted by Poison Lady to gather intelligence on the Wang Quan family, regains her freedom with Fu Gui’s help. As their...

programme.title: 加油我的人生 / Bravo, My Life Episode 117
programme.desc:
徐冬熙梦想成为服装设计师，一场突如其来的意外，却让她必须领养侄子成为了单亲妈妈，多亏家人及邻居协助，让她在照顾侄子之余仍得以重拾曾经放弃的梦想。姜次烈则年幼时父亲去世，其后被叔叔收养，虽曾有彷徨时期，但他头脑聪明、成绩和外貌出众，可是他做的越好，哥哥和妈妈的表情就越冷淡。为了迎合母亲的喜好，次烈无法凭自己的意愿生活，虽然不想继承家族企业却被安排进入公司工作，虽不开心但也只能等着离开这个家独立的日子…

programme.desc: 著名女演员朴道萝个性独特，她之所以成为演员，是因为母亲告诉她，这是脱离贫穷的唯一方法。透过成名而得到人气和金钱，道萝心底却希望可以休息，可是母亲却一直闯祸、挥霍生活，还贪图更多。母亲的欲望令道萝开始承受不了繁忙的工作，打算放弃参与新剧。就在这时，她遇上了初恋高必胜，也就是新剧的副导演。必胜对于工作充满热情，但因为道萝而决定放弃新剧。一次意外让道萝掉进必胜怀里，两人的人生从此再次连上。Top actress Park Do Ra rose to fame at her mother Baek Mi Ja's urge to escape poverty. programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 29
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 天地剑心 / Sword and Beloved Episode 3
programme.desc: 王权富贵是王权弘业和东方淮竹的儿子，是王权世家实力最强者。被家族作为道门兵人培养的王权富贵，生活没有自由，而清瞳本来是毒娘子安排到王权家打听情报的间谍，和王权富贵结识后，在富贵的帮助下恢复了自由。同时王权富贵内心渴望自由、憧憬天下大同的信念亦被逐渐点燃，经历万剑穿心，王权富贵带着清瞳离开王权山庄，走上了自己所悟之道。Wang Quan Fu Gui is the son of Wang Quan Hong Ye and Dongfang Huai Zhu, and the most powerful member of the Wang Quan family. programme.desc:

programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。

programme.title: 现在很美丽 / It's Beautiful Now
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事。李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫。 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊。 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作。 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓。 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师。 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医。 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备。 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 868
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季 / Breakfast In China S5
programme.desc: 《早餐中国》第5季，30种热气腾腾的早餐，30种人生况味。我们依然在拍摄那些微不足道的民间食物，依然在见证那些触手可及的人间奇迹。

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季 / The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2 Episode 10
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.desc: 著名女演员朴道萝个性独特，她之所以成为演员，是因为母亲告诉她，这是脱离贫穷的唯一方法。透过成名而得到人气和金钱，道萝心底却希望可以休息，可是母亲却一直闯祸、挥霍生活，还贪图更多。母亲的欲望令道萝开始承受不了繁忙的工作，打算放弃参与新剧。就在这时，她遇上了初恋高必胜，也就是新剧的副导演。必胜对于工作充满热情，但因为道萝而决定放弃新剧。一次意外让道萝掉进必胜怀里，两人的人生从此再次连上。Top actress Park Do Ra rose to fame at her mother Baek Mi Ja's urge to escape poverty. programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 868
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季 / Breakfast In China S5
programme.desc: 《早餐中国》第5季，30种热气腾腾的早餐，30种人生况味。我们依然在拍摄那些微不足道的民间食物，依然在见证那些触手可及的人间奇迹。

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季 / The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2 Episode 10
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.title: 西出玉门 / Parallel World Episode 7

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 / Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: In Shanghai's finance world, Qian Fei clashes with elite investor Li Yifei, while boyfriend Wang Ruohai accepts Liao Shiyu's job offer and grows close to her. Qian Fei witnesses their intimacy and confronts him.

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 / Love Has Fireworks Episode 2
programme.desc: Wang Ruohai ends the relationship. After Li Yifei rescues Qian Fei from harassment, she faces work setbacks, rents out her spare room to ease her mortgage, and finds her new tenant is Li Yifei.

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 / Love Has Fireworks Episode 3
programme.desc: Li Yifei helps Qian Fei after her flat is flooded. A misleading photo scandal costs her job, both relationships collapse, and a mistaken rescue photo draws the reluctant roommates closer.

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 / Love Has Fireworks Episode 4
programme.desc: Li Yifei buries himself in the Shanlifang case as Qian Fei struggles through interviews and receives his practical help. Their home life warms, while Dajun develops a crush on Dang Yu.

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队 / The Best Team Episode 8
programme.desc: 《全城地图：最强明星队》是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝、红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗。该节目以“将城市化为竞技场”为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀。The Best Team” is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 亦舞之城 / Second Chance Romance Episode 11
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 10
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 869
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 美女与纯情男 / Beauty and Mr Romantic Episode 12
programme.desc: 著名女演员朴道萝个性独特，她之所以成为演员，是因为母亲告诉她，这是脱离贫穷的唯一方法。透过成名而得到人气和金钱，道萝心底却希望可以休息，可是母亲却一直闯祸、挥霍生活，还贪图更多。母亲的欲望令道萝开始承受不了繁忙的工作，打算放弃参与新剧。就在这时，她遇上了初恋高必胜，也就是新剧的副导演。必胜对于工作充满热情，但因为道萝而决定放弃新剧。一次意外让道萝掉进必胜怀里，两人的人生从此再次连上。Top actress Park Do Ra rose to fame at her mother Baek Mi Ja's urge to escape poverty. Now wealthy, Do Ra longs to rest but Mi Ja’s relentless ambition keeps her working. Mi Ja pushes Do Ra into more roles. programme.title: 榴莲小姐 / Durian's Affair
programme.desc: 朝鲜时代的榴莲，虽然嫁给朴氏，但她所爱的，却是为了救她而身亡的仆人石头。榴莲和石头的儿子朴温，和金素苧成婚后爱上彼此，但朴温却骤然离世。悲痛的两名女子，在月食之夜穿越时空，来到她们心爱的人所投胎转世的丹家家族。

programme.title: 一城一味 长安有滋味 / One City One Taste Xi An Episode 4
programme.desc: 《一城一味·长安有滋味》将以西安为核心，辐射咸阳、宝鸡、榆林、汉中等地，从地域美食、风土人情等方面切入，通过一个个鲜活生动的故事，以小见大，多方位记录和展现一座城的多维之味，让观众品尝到陕西人的热度与温度。

programme.desc: Check in with Andrew and Melissa, whose house purchase was supposed to bring security and comfort to their expanding family. See Mike outline some home inspection misses and signs of neglect that Damon and the crew will make right and watertight.

programme.title: Holmes Inspection Season 1 Episode 17
programme.desc: Tour Kathie's new townhouse, which was supposed to be a downsizing dream for this police officer on disability. Uncover the worrying issues the home inspector missed and see Mike, Damon, and the team ramp down the stress and deliver peace of mind.

programme.title: Holmes on Homes Season 4 Episode 9
programme.desc: Confront the indoor air pollutants that have been making Jayson, Tammy, and their infant son, Jacob, sick. Stand by as Mike calls in a team of experts to banish not only dangerous black mould but also asbestos so the family can breathe easier.

programme.title: Holmes Makes It Right Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Partner with investigative journalist Pat Foran as Mike hunts for the con artist contractor who bilked Sheila and Val out of their money, their kitchen, and their trust. Examine his rap sheet and learn the cheap tricks that lure unsuspecting clients.

programme.title: Holmes Makes It Right Season 2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Travel to High River, Alberta, with the Holmes crew as they help a family pick up the pieces after a historic flood. Discover a happy surprise beneath the surface of John and Gillian's home and celebrate the prospect of a reno instead of a rebuild.

programme.title: Custom Built Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Tour Terri's reimagined dream kitchen, complete with a made-to-order breakfast bar and entertaining area that's worth the 20-year wait. Then check out Kimberly's mid-century modern media centre, which Paul perfectly fits around her flat-screen TV.

programme.title: Custom Built Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: Dial up the drama when Paul guts David and Laura's kitchen, tweaking the layout and adding a splashy backsplash that'll be the backdrop to their entertaining dreams. Then check out Thea's vanity, which is made-to-measure for a zombie lover like her.

programme.title: Decked Out Season 3 Episode 3
programme.desc: Take in an over-the-top deck that's made to order for executive chef Boris and his wife, Keren. Stand by as Paul and the crew fashion a lavish relaxation zone, with a gleaming stainless steel kitchen and pergola, hanging fireplace, and putting green.

programme.title: Decks, Docks and Gazebos Season 1 Episode 9
programme.desc: Take a shortcut to success when Colin whips up a quick, lightweight, removable metal pole dock for a busy family of five. Discover how this simple, one-day project revamps dock life for parents Bryan and Michelle and their three young sons.

programme.title: Backroad Bounty Season 2 Episode 9
programme.desc: Watch as Bam Bam and Marty randomly head into a yard sale, only to be greeted by the owner and a rifle. The boys also discover a pop culture bonanza and Marty may have just bought his biggest bounty of the season.

programme.title: Extreme Collectors Season 1
programme.desc: In this episode Andrew is in L.A., where he is left speechless by actor Corbin Bernsen's jaw-dropping collection of 8,000 snow globes!

programme.title: Collector Showdown Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: Two shoe fanatics go head-to-head in tests of knowledge and skill.

programme.title: Crazy Beautiful Weddings Season 1 Episode 7

programme.title: Coolest Places to Stay Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Roll up your sleeves with three DIY-savvy rental owners. Learn how Erin and Brad rehabbed a crumbling A-frame with stunning lake views, tour Arden and Matt's updated rural bungalow, and kick back in Marjut and Allan's handcrafted bohemian apartment.

programme.title: Best Cake Wins Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Watch the star bakers attempt a one-of-a-kind disco rainbow unicorn cake filled with candy that explodes out of it when sliced. See whose colourful creation makes the cut and gets to be the sweet centrepiece at the eight-year-old designer's party.

programme.title: Donut Showdown Season 1 Episode 4

programme.title: Holmes Inspection Season 1 Episode 16

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Arsenal (MW27) Episode 269
programme.desc: Spurs have lost their last three Premier League home games against Arsenal, as many as they had in their previous 23 (W10 D10). They last lost four in a row against them between 1952 and 1955.

programme.title: Burnley vs Brentford (MW28) Episode 273
programme.desc: Brentford have won three of their last four league games against Burnley (L1) and are looking to complete the league double over the Clarets for just the second time after 1934-35.

programme.title: Aston Villa vs Chelsea (MW29) Episode 285
programme.desc: Following their 2-1 victory at Stamford Bridge earlier this season, Aston Villa are looking to complete a league double over Chelsea for the first time since the 1989-90 campaign.

programme.title: Newcastle United vs Sunderland (MW31) Episode 307
programme.desc: Sunderland are unbeaten in their last 10 league games against Newcastle (W7 D3), winning seven of the last eight. It's the joint-longest run either side has had without defeat in the history of the fixture (Newcastle also 10 between 1985 and 1997).

programme.title: Manchester City vs Arsenal (MW33) Episode 329
programme.desc: Manchester City are unbeaten in their last 10 Premier League home games against Arsenal (W7 D3) since a 2-0 loss in January 2015 under Manuel Pellegrini.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Aston Villa (MW30) Episode 297
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just two of their last 37 home league games against Aston Villa (W28 D7), going down 1-0 both times in December 2009 and September 2021.

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Brighton and Hove Albion (MW33) Episode 324
programme.desc: Tottenham are winless in their last three Premier League games against Brighton (D1 L2), having previously never gone more than once without a win against the Seagulls in the top-flight.

programme.title: Aston Villa vs Sunderland (MW33) Episode 326
programme.desc: Aston Villa have lost just one of their last 13 league games against Sunderland (W6 D6), going down 3-1 at the Stadium of Light in January 2016.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Nottingham Forest (MW35) Episode 349
programme.desc: Chelsea have lost, and failed to score, in each of their last five Premier League games; they haven't lost six in a row since November 1993, while they've never lost six in succession without scoring in their league history.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Brentford (MW34) Episode 340
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost their last two league games against Brentford, more than they had in their previous 11 (W8 D2 L1).

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool (MW33) Episode 327
programme.desc: Everton have won just one of their last 14 Premier League home games against Liverpool, though 10 of those games have finished level (L3).

programme.title: Manchester City vs Brentford (MW36) Episode 355
programme.desc: Though they've only failed to score in one of their nine Premier League games against Brentford, Man City's average of 1.4 goals per game against the Bees (13 in 9) is their lowest against any opponent they've faced under Pep Guardiola.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool (MW35) Episode 348
programme.desc: Manchester United have won just three of their last 19 Premier League games against Liverpool (D9 L7), though are looking to complete the league double over the Reds for the first time since 2015-16.

programme.title: Everton vs Manchester City (MW35) Episode 350
programme.desc: Manchester City are unbeaten in their last 11 league games (W8 D3), collecting more points (24) and conceding fewer goals (8) than any other side during that run.

programme.title: Aston Villa vs Liverpool (MW37) Episode 361
programme.desc: Aston Villa have won just one of their last 16 Premier League games against Liverpool (D3 L12), a 7-2 home win in October 2020.

programme.title: Bournemouth vs Manchester City (MW37) Episode 369
programme.desc: Bournemouth are unbeaten in their last 16 Premier League games (W8 D8), the longest run of any side in the competition this season. The Cherries have won four of their last five, as many as they had in their previous 22 combined (D12 L6).

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Everton (MW38) Episode 379
programme.desc: Tottenham are winless in their last 10 home league games (D4 L6), their second-longest run in their league history after a 14-game streak between October 1993 and April 1994.

programme.desc: Shizuoka has everything from beaches to mountains, but this time our road takes us through its deep forests, from wild rides on timber trails to a wild taste experience in the birthplace of wasabi.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Samurai Wisdom
programme.desc: Yoshimune, the shogun who saved the city of Edo. Through disaster and economic strife, alongside its people, his wisdom shaped the future of the place now called Tokyo.

programme.title: Cinematic Journey
programme.desc: Kyle Card explores the San'in Kaigan Geopark, discovering Yumura's hot springs, Ojiro's hillside rice terraces and heritage Tajima beef, as well as the Oriental White Stork wetlands of Toyooka.

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE
programme.desc: We attend a New Year's concert at a samurai residence, where a master koto player delights a crowd of gorgeously dressed celebrity-types. Lounging in the best seat in the house is no ordinary V.I.P.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE

programme.title: BOSAI: Science that Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: When a major earthquake hits, the ground can turn into muddy water. This is called liquefaction. Buildings may sink or tilt and become uninhabitable. Find out the mechanisms and how to prevent it.

programme.title: DESIGN MUSEUM JAPAN
programme.desc: Aichi / Kataoka Mami (curator) Tokoname, a pottery town with over 900 years of history, creates products appropriate for the times. Kataoka finds the beauty that's present in functional objects.

programme.title: KABUKI KOOL
programme.desc: Explore the different types of romantic hero who appear in kabuki. From sweet, comic charmers to brooding bad boys, actor Kataoka Ainosuke explains these heroic archetypes.

programme.title: Documentary 360
programme.desc: Israeli strikes continue in Gaza. Using maps based on satellite imagery, open-source intelligence, and testimony, we reveal the full extent of destruction and examine where the occupation is heading.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current Episode 2
programme.desc: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but it's the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the foundation for an intricate marine food chain

programme.title: The Humboldt Current Episode 3
programme.desc: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a study in survival.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Owls
programme.desc: This stunning series uncovers 'The Secret Life Of Owls' as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Owls Episode 2

programme.title: Jaguarland
programme.desc: Explore a 400 square mile region of the Pantanal where jaguars rule and life follows the seasonal rhythm of the water.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: In Chile's Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bays are magnets for rare dolphins and orcas.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Museum S3 Episode 5
programme.desc: This week, conservator Adriana cleans a Donatello sculpture, Simon receives Helen Mirren's costume from "The Audience," Christopher meets designer Sir Kenneth Grange, and V&A Dundee recruits artist Yinka Ilori for a colorful maze.

programme.title: The Dinosaur Echo
programme.desc: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

programme.title: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
programme.desc: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

programme.title: Jaguarland
programme.desc: Explore a 400 square mile region of the Pantanal where jaguars rule and life follows the seasonal rhythm of the water.

programme.title: Wild Portugal
programme.desc: Portugal's diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

programme.desc: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs' spring rituals, and Grebes' dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

programme.desc: Darwin's only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

programme.title: Taste Of The Territory Episode 8
programme.desc: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

programme.title: Taste Of The Territory
programme.desc: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

programme.title: Taste Of The Territory Episode 2

programme.title: Taste Of The Territory Episode 3

programme.title: Taste Of The Territory Episode 4
programme.desc: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

programme.title: Growing Up Grizzly: A Tale Of Two Orphans
programme.desc: After 18 years of raising an orphaned bear named Brutus, Casey Anderson will do anything to ensure no bears have to live in a man made sanctuary. His resolve is put to the test one year when he is notified of 2 recently orphaned grizzly cubs.

programme.title: In The Giant Mammoth Tracks
programme.desc: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, little-known giant back to life.

programme.title: Iceland: The Puffin Sanctuary
programme.desc: The endearing, "comical" puffin is Iceland's national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

programme.title: Wild Portugal Episode 3
programme.desc: Portugal's coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

programme.title: Islands Of Creation
programme.desc: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing discovery in the Solomon Islands, but there's a threat looming on the horizon.

programme.title: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild
programme.desc: Exploring the wilderness and wildlife of the Atlantic Ocean. Winter brings bitter storms, suffering and conflict, while most are battling to survive.

programme.title: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild Episode 2
programme.desc: As winter draws to a close, the Atlantic springs back to life. Fish that spent the winter out in the deeper water have returned. An eagle pair has set up home high above the perfect fishing spot.

programme.title: Wild Portugal
programme.desc: Portugal's diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

programme.title: Wild Portugal Episode 2
programme.desc: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs' spring rituals, and Grebes' dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

programme.title: Sea Hunters
programme.desc: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

programme.title: Wild Heroes Episode 4
programme.desc: This time on Wild Heroes, there's shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

programme.title: Meteor Part 1
programme.desc: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

programme.title: Meteor Part 2
programme.desc: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

programme.title: The Dinosaur Echo
programme.desc: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMA's expert team as they repair some of the world's biggest antennas.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 Episode 3
programme.desc: The worldwide pandemic ceased operations on the world's only underwater habitat. Mike Davidson joins a crack repair crew as they dive in to bring it back to life and get NASA astronauts back inside for training.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 Episode 4
programme.desc: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Witness the story of President Clinton's impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Witness how America's South and Midwest were ravaged by 148 twisters in just 18 hours.

programme.title: Aerial Italy Episode 3
programme.desc: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italy's Islands.

programme.title: Aerial Italy Episode 4
programme.desc: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild Episode 4
programme.desc: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild
programme.desc: The end of winter heralds one of the world's greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild Episode 2
programme.desc: With the arrival of spring, days grow longer and temperatures rise. However, spring in Alaska is short. Animals have just two months to find food and start a family, while avoiding predators.

programme.title: Wild Portugal
programme.desc: Portugal's diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 1
programme.desc: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Launch into spring's snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Weave through Queensland's coastal chaos, where Jess faces her fears chasing a lace monitor lizard up a tree with an active beehive. Watch Stu cut a trapped eastern brown out of a fence and see Mick hunt a slippery python for terrified homeowners.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowner's pets.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv's hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who's swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tim's squirrel glider knee surgery.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Celebrate Cash the house donkey's birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom's most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3 Episode 6
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.desc: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einstein's defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome Anna's clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Anna's scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Follow the Bay Family's matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies' leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Chase Anna to the Townies' lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies' first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park's main attraction.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It's a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who've been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: Stormborn Season 1
programme.desc: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

programme.title: Stormborn Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Experience the north Atlantic's intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

programme.title: Stormborn Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard that's chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.desc: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 724
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 / Warm And Sweet Episode 22
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 229
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第一季 / Earthly Ambrosia S1 Episode 5
programme.desc: 《大地餐桌》走访西南乡野，探寻当地饮食文化，以人物故事串连食材、菜肴与本土的饮食习惯，展现当地滋味与食物有关的情感故事。The series traverses the countryside of southwest China in exploration of the local food culture, connecting the local produce with dishes through personal stories, showcasing the local flavors.

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 / Pretty Dangerous Episode 2
programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 17
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 968
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 259
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.desc: 本剧由白冰冰担任制作人并领衔主演，集结了超坚强的卡司，包括资深戏骨及新生代演员，以现代生活为背景，讲述了玄天上帝在人间济世救人、感化世间暴戾的感人故事。剧情强调“善的力量”与因果报应，展现信仰如何感化世间的种种恶行与怨气，是一部正向感人、充满信念的作品。Produced and led by Bai Bingbing, this series features a star-studded cast comprising veterans and upcoming stars. programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 38
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 / Warm And Sweet Episode 23
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.desc: 本剧由白冰冰担任制作人并领衔主演，集结了超坚强的卡司，包括资深戏骨及新生代演员，以现代生活为背景，讲述了玄天上帝在人间济世救人、感化世间暴戾的感人故事。剧情强调“善的力量”与因果报应，展现信仰如何感化世间的种种恶行与怨气，是一部正向感人、充满信念的作品。Produced and led by Bai Bingbing, this series features a star-studded cast comprising veterans and upcoming stars. programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 40
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 / Pretty Dangerous Episode 5
programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 20
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 262
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 / Pretty Dangerous Episode 6
programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 968
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 724
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 195
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 230
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 综艺新时代 / New Style Episode 19
programme.desc: 【综艺新时代】，发现台湾好所在。三位主持秉持“主持职人“的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众。Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmen—masters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the island’s truest charm.

programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.title: 好事成双 / Alliance Episode 11
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: 春色寄情人 / Will Love In Spring Episode 19
programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师。庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英。一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的“不完美”。

programme.title: 好事成双 / Alliance Episode 13
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: 好事成双 / Alliance Episode 14
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: 春色寄情人 / Will Love In Spring Episode 21
programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师。庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英。一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的“不完美”。

programme.title: 下饭江湖第三季 / The Soul of a Meal S3
programme.desc: 《下饭江湖 第三季》通过食物讲述与之间紧密相连的人的故事，这群普通人活出了价值、尊严、自信，让观众从中获得些许勇气，同时有一种共鸣，就是每一个人都要为之奋斗的精神。希望通过节目把这种平凡人的奋斗精神、以及人间值得的烟火气传递给更多还在寻找生活真谛的人们。

programme.title: 这一秒过火 / Overdo
programme.desc: Fresh from prison, Murong Qingyi is forced into a political marriage, then a stolen film reel and a gentian flower revive the lover he thought dead. At his brother's engagement, her face appears again... as his future sister-in-law.

programme.title: 这一秒过火 / Overdo Episode 2
programme.desc: Three years earlier, anonymous letters thaw Qingyi's guarded heart and lead him to Ren Susu. In the present, the woman wearing Susu's face denies knowing him, while old betrayals, a prison sentence and a dangerous film reel reopen every wound.

programme.title: 烈焰 / Burning Flames Episode 13
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: 春色寄情人 / Will Love In Spring Episode 21
programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师。庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英。一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的“不完美”。

programme.title: 下饭江湖第三季 / The Soul of a Meal S3
programme.desc: 《下饭江湖 第三季》通过食物讲述与之间紧密相连的人的故事，这群普通人活出了价值、尊严、自信，让观众从中获得些许勇气，同时有一种共鸣，就是每一个人都要为之奋斗的精神。希望通过节目把这种平凡人的奋斗精神、以及人间值得的烟火气传递给更多还在寻找生活真谛的人们。

programme.title: 这一秒过火 / Overdo
programme.desc: Fresh from prison, Murong Qingyi is forced into a political marriage, then a stolen film reel and a gentian flower revive the lover he thought dead. At his brother's engagement, her face appears again... as his future sister-in-law.

programme.title: 这一秒过火 / Overdo Episode 2
programme.desc: Three years earlier, anonymous letters thaw Qingyi's guarded heart and lead him to Ren Susu. In the present, the woman wearing Susu's face denies knowing him, while old betrayals, a prison sentence and a dangerous film reel reopen every wound.

programme.title: 哑舍 / The Company
programme.desc:
来自未来的古董店老板毕之和活在现代的宠物医生苏北陆组成合作伙伴，一起踏上寻回古董的时光之旅。不同时期的风土人情、跌宕起伏的人生境遇，在二人的穿针引线间被娓娓道来。在这一过程中，他们收获了跨时空的友情，最终满怀乐观地面对各自的人生。

Through futuristic technology—the Time Elevator—they embark on bizarre adventures through various historical eras. programme.title: 新闻掏宝 / News Treasury 2026 Episode 28
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报导，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: 开心无敌奖门人 / Super Trio Returns Episode 19
programme.desc: 《奖门人系列》踏入25周年，「奖门人」曾志伟宣布节目载誉归来！奖门人带领钱嘉乐、阮兆祥，以及新加入的「奖老」麦美恩、程浩骏、吴嘉仪，每集广邀最好玩的嘉宾好友，参与多个爆笑游戏，送上无穷无尽的欢乐笑弹，务求为全港观众带来最愉快的星期日晚上，继续发放开心正能量！

programme.title: 中年好声音4 / Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4 Episode 34
programme.desc: 《中年好声音4》宣布启航，延续前三季的成功，再次为歌唱爱好者筑建逐梦舞台。本季更将招募版图扩展至北美、澳洲等地，还有TVB多位艺员「蒙面」出战，让音乐之火燃遍全球，照亮无数追梦者的心弦。车婉婉继续主持大局，以温暖笑容陪伴一众选手；肥妈、周国丰、张佳添、海儿、谷娅溦亦坐镇评审席，为参赛者提供专业点评与鼓励。在新一季的舞台上，大家将以音乐交织出更动人的篇章，续写属于《中年好声音》的真摰故事。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 221
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港小姐湘遇记 / Miss Hong Kong Pageant 2026 Hunan Moments Episode 3
programme.desc: 新一届(2026年)「香港小姐竞选」的12位佳丽于湖南之旅分成三个小组，分别向「师姐」冯盈盈、黄嘉雯、陈懿德请教选美心得。佳丽们会换上华丽汉服，在南岳里庙会民俗主题美食文化街区打卡争艳；再穿着旗袍到著名地标「1944小镇」参与巡游；纵返到民宿稍歇，也会做好穿泳衣的准备踏入Q&A环节。长沙、衡阳还有更多景点，有待众佳丽一一发掘，跟老师学习湘绣技巧；而刺激的激流漂流体验，同样在这趟旅程的行程列表之中。

programme.title: 一周星星 / Star Weekly Episode 35
programme.desc: 访谈节目《一周星星》，每集邀请星级艺人、界别名人，与区永权、许文轩、王镇泉等娱乐主播，分享新近工作企划，谈论电影、电视、演唱会相关的特别话题，尤其是网民与圈中朋友关心热议的人和事！周边讯息如此多，节目特设「Fact Check」核实环节，由嘉宾亲自回应各式各样的传闻，让当事人说清楚个中真相！

programme.title: 流行经典50年 / Cantopop At 50 Episode 125
programme.desc: 中外乐坛历年来诞生无数金曲，不论甚么年代的作品，皆各有知音人。《流行经典50年》邀请原唱人或实力歌手，再次演绎这些流行一时，兼且跨越多代的经典，为乐迷带来高质素的音乐享受。除了具份量的乐坛前辈之外，不少久未露面的歌手亦应邀在节目现身，献给观众多重惊喜。

programme.title: 财经透视 / Finance Magazine 2026 Episode 32

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 19
programme.desc: 第十九集 啓堂為康復提出到瑞士休養。有節能水力公司準備來港上市，原來欲借傲堂炒作話題，定垚差點上當幸得高哲出手解圍。高哲再提出大嶼山發電站項目，定垚終被打動。敬賢隱藏身份調查克網來歷，卻不得要領。程凱與澤雨對智能家居的發展充滿憧憬，松蔭卻提醒澤雨要加快進度。高哲與定垚就大嶼山項目展開爭奪戰！

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递 / Lo And Behold Episode 1864
programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 重症解密 / Severe Case Decoded Episode 10
programme.desc: 节目锁定不同重症，以深入浅出的方式道出顽疾成因、病理机制、最新治疗方案和预防方法。谭俊彦、陈晓华、林秀怡、梁凯晴化身「重症调查科」调查员，四出搜罗线索、证物、证人，务求解开各种致命危疾的重重疑团。来自香港各大公立与私家医院，及本地大学医学院的资深医生与学者，结合真实病例、医疗影像，令复杂的医学知识变得贴地，让大众更全面认知重症的诊治过程，减少误解与恐惧，也鼓励港人及早检查、及时治疗，守护健康未来。

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 / Mrs. Revenge Episode 5
programme.desc: 善良的幸如(高海宁饰)，活于丈夫施继威(张颕康饰)的压榨下，罹患绝症。她撞破丈夫与唯一闺蜜潘雪文(郭柏妍饰)的奸情，争执间被推出马路惨遭车撞。然而，幸如突然醒来，发现一切似乎只是场梦。但当梦中场景接连应验，她意识到这或是预知梦。为改写命运，幸如决心扭转梦中的悲剧。幸如不仅要摆脱渣男与假闺蜜，更设法撮合二人，让雪文「接手」其原本的不幸。她又善用梦境记忆、换上亮丽外型，在职场力争上游，还和并肩作战的上司叶家谦(马国明饰)渐生情愫，最终开拓幸福人生！

programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.title: 万福金安 & 今日知多D / Wan Fu Jin An & What's On Today Episode 4
programme.desc: 皇后顾清（王艺瑾 饰）遭人陷害，命丧一场精心布局的大火，却意外重生到尚衣局婢女凤卿（方瑾 饰）身上。从高高在上的皇后变成身份卑微的宫女，凤卿没有被悲痛击倒，为了保护妹妹顾婉（吴曼思 饰），亦为查出自己遇害真相、揪出幕后真凶，她决定暂时隐藏锋芒，以凤卿身份在深宫中低调蛰伏。 凤卿深知单靠一己之力难以翻案，于是暗中联络身为太医的弟弟顾玹（储子竣 饰）。姐弟二人默契十足，连手在后宫各方势力之间周旋，一边避开重重刁难与陷阱，一边搜集线索，与宫中奸佞斗智斗力。 在这场复仇与守护交织的博弈中，凤卿与帝王萧骆（赵华为 饰）再度产生交集。萧骆一直对顾清的「惨死」心存疑窦，更隐约觉得凤卿身上有顾清的影子，因此不断试探她。凤卿面对萧骆亦是百感交集，二人在一次又一次交锋与拉扯之间，逐步解开昔日误会，前世未了的羁绊亦悄然延续。

programme.title: 重症解密 / Severe Case Decoded Episode 10
programme.desc: 节目锁定不同重症，以深入浅出的方式道出顽疾成因、病理机制、最新治疗方案和预防方法。谭俊彦、陈晓华、林秀怡、梁凯晴化身「重症调查科」调查员，四出搜罗线索、证物、证人，务求解开各种致命危疾的重重疑团。来自香港各大公立与私家医院，及本地大学医学院的资深医生与学者，结合真实病例、医疗影像，令复杂的医学知识变得贴地，让大众更全面认知重症的诊治过程，减少误解与恐惧，也鼓励港人及早检查、及时治疗，守护健康未来。

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express Episode 165
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。

programme.title: 仨心友行 / Walking With You Episode 9
programme.desc:
第12集 海边Hea吓倾吓偈 沙巴有一集住宅、购物中心、酒店等建设的大型项目，众人参观示范单位，巧遇在当地发展饮食生意的香港人，顺道向她了解投资商机。
品尝地道炒粉面美食期间，马贯东提到退休后希望移居海边，享受宁静生活。三位美女闻言即租下一辆特色露营车，带他到沙滩「Hea吓倾吓偈」。海风轻轻吹起，贯东打开心扉，还对着镜头向家人吐心声。美女们又重提为贯东炮制的惊喜生日会，贯东如何被整？
行程尾声，三位闺密乘船出海，互诉旅途深刻点滴。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 396
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 在你的冬夜里闪耀 / Winter Night Episode 22
programme.desc:
在城市漂泊惨遭爱情事业双重打击的社畜郑达前(乔欣饰)，否极泰来得到东北老家拆迁款，踏上了返乡之行。火流星引发的磁暴，火车在旷野中滞留。目睹了火流星的郑达前没想到时空就此发生错乱，她来到了平行时空！
在这她见到了死去的父亲，未曾离婚远走的母亲，儿时的玩伴、错过的初恋慕子李(马思超饰)！无法返回原世界的郑达前，抓住这次机会，将以前的遗憾一一弥补，而她与慕子李过去的一段朦胧恋情，真爱的种子也随春的到来萌发了。可惜火流星再度出现，郑达前和慕子李即将成为被分割两个世界触不到的恋人……！

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导& 世界观 & 今日知多D / News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 222
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 / Mrs. Revenge Episode 6
programme.desc: 善良的幸如(高海宁饰)，活于丈夫施继威(张颕康饰)的压榨下，罹患绝症。她撞破丈夫与唯一闺蜜潘雪文(郭柏妍饰)的奸情，争执间被推出马路惨遭车撞。然而，幸如突然醒来，发现一切似乎只是场梦。但当梦中场景接连应验，她意识到这或是预知梦。为改写命运，幸如决心扭转梦中的悲剧。幸如不仅要摆脱渣男与假闺蜜，更设法撮合二人，让雪文「接手」其原本的不幸。她又善用梦境记忆、换上亮丽外型，在职场力争上游，还和并肩作战的上司叶家谦(马国明饰)渐生情愫，最终开拓幸福人生！

programme.title: 娱乐头条 / EXTRA Episode 798
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态、剧集和电影宣传、演唱会精华、颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事、追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌、影、视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息。

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 世界观 / Global View
programme.desc: 由资深新闻工作者负责的《世界观》，带你用世界观、观世界，更阔更广看新闻、长知识。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 19
programme.desc: 第十九集 啓堂為康復提出到瑞士休養。有節能水力公司準備來港上市，原來欲借傲堂炒作話題，定垚差點上當幸得高哲出手解圍。高哲再提出大嶼山發電站項目，定垚終被打動。敬賢隱藏身份調查克網來歷，卻不得要領。程凱與澤雨對智能家居的發展充滿憧憬，松蔭卻提醒澤雨要加快進度。高哲與定垚就大嶼山項目展開爭奪戰！

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 159
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 95
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 新闻掏宝 / News Treasury 2026 Episode 28
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报导，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 20
programme.desc: 第二十集 高哲與非原居民代表康年見面，對方似與傲堂有私人恩怨。依寧給敬賢帶來天生的黑材料，但敬賢選擇親自訪問天生。天生被詹兆齊出賣令競選商會主席失敗，懷恨在心。程凱答應報告進度卻睡過頭，澤雨只好拿出尚未完善的智能家居1.0來匯報。程凱大發雷霆兄弟倆差點反目。天生勸海泉賣地不果，直斥海泉沒本事！

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 210
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 重症解密 & 今日知多D / Severe Case Decoded & What's On Today Episode 9
programme.desc: 节目锁定不同重症，以深入浅出的方式道出顽疾成因、病理机制、最新治疗方案和预防方法。谭俊彦、陈晓华、林秀怡、梁凯晴化身「重症调查科」调查员，四出搜罗线索、证物、证人，务求解开各种致命危疾的重重疑团。来自香港各大公立与私家医院，及本地大学医学院的资深医生与学者，结合真实病例、医疗影像，令复杂的医学知识变得贴地，让大众更全面认知重症的诊治过程，减少误解与恐惧，也鼓励港人及早检查、及时治疗，守护健康未来。

programme.title: 仨心友行 / Walking With You Episode 9
programme.desc:
第12集 海边Hea吓倾吓偈 沙巴有一集住宅、购物中心、酒店等建设的大型项目，众人参观示范单位，巧遇在当地发展饮食生意的香港人，顺道向她了解投资商机。
品尝地道炒粉面美食期间，马贯东提到退休后希望移居海边，享受宁静生活。三位美女闻言即租下一辆特色露营车，带他到沙滩「Hea吓倾吓偈」。海风轻轻吹起，贯东打开心扉，还对着镜头向家人吐心声。美女们又重提为贯东炮制的惊喜生日会，贯东如何被整？
行程尾声，三位闺密乘船出海，互诉旅途深刻点滴。

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 / Mrs. Revenge Episode 6
programme.desc: 善良的幸如(高海宁饰)，活于丈夫施继威(张颕康饰)的压榨下，罹患绝症。她撞破丈夫与唯一闺蜜潘雪文(郭柏妍饰)的奸情，争执间被推出马路惨遭车撞。然而，幸如突然醒来，发现一切似乎只是场梦。但当梦中场景接连应验，她意识到这或是预知梦。为改写命运，幸如决心扭转梦中的悲剧。幸如不仅要摆脱渣男与假闺蜜，更设法撮合二人，让雪文「接手」其原本的不幸。她又善用梦境记忆、换上亮丽外型，在职场力争上游，还和并肩作战的上司叶家谦(马国明饰)渐生情愫，最终开拓幸福人生！

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 222
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 396
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 160
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 万福金安 & 今日知多D / Wan Fu Jin An & What's On Today Episode 5
programme.desc: 皇后顾清（王艺瑾 饰）遭人陷害，命丧一场精心布局的大火，却意外重生到尚衣局婢女凤卿（方瑾 饰）身上。从高高在上的皇后变成身份卑微的宫女，凤卿没有被悲痛击倒，为了保护妹妹顾婉（吴曼思 饰），亦为查出自己遇害真相、揪出幕后真凶，她决定暂时隐藏锋芒，以凤卿身份在深宫中低调蛰伏。 凤卿深知单靠一己之力难以翻案，于是暗中联络身为太医的弟弟顾玹（储子竣 饰）。姐弟二人默契十足，连手在后宫各方势力之间周旋，一边避开重重刁难与陷阱，一边搜集线索，与宫中奸佞斗智斗力。 在这场复仇与守护交织的博弈中，凤卿与帝王萧骆（赵华为 饰）再度产生交集。萧骆一直对顾清的「惨死」心存疑窦，更隐约觉得凤卿身上有顾清的影子，因此不断试探她。凤卿面对萧骆亦是百感交集，二人在一次又一次交锋与拉扯之间，逐步解开昔日误会，前世未了的羁绊亦悄然延续。

programme.title: 重症解密 / Severe Case Decoded Episode 11
programme.desc: 节目锁定不同重症，以深入浅出的方式道出顽疾成因、病理机制、最新治疗方案和预防方法。谭俊彦、陈晓华、林秀怡、梁凯晴化身「重症调查科」调查员，四出搜罗线索、证物、证人，务求解开各种致命危疾的重重疑团。来自香港各大公立与私家医院，及本地大学医学院的资深医生与学者，结合真实病例、医疗影像，令复杂的医学知识变得贴地，让大众更全面认知重症的诊治过程，减少误解与恐惧，也鼓励港人及早检查、及时治疗，守护健康未来。

programme.title: 呃钱 / Scam Alert! Episode 8
programme.desc: 各类骗案数字持续上升，涉及的款项亦甚夸张。据悉香港每日平均损失达2500万元，每13分钟就有一宗骗案发生……网购、求职、投资、交友应用程序、电话骗案等行骗招数越来越高明，市民要及时提高防骗意识，慎防中伏！主持区永权、萧正楠、李旻芳、梁敏巧网罗不同真实个案，深入了解事主被骗经过，节目还会以故事形式重现个中情节。专家们现身拆解不同犯案手法，协助观众辨识《呃钱》陷阱，避免成为骗徒目标！

programme.title: 阿爷厨房 / The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5) Episode 3
programme.desc: 鐵漢李家鼎(鼎爺)武藝非凡毋庸置疑，原來廚藝亦相當「耍家」！鼎爺設立「阿爺廚房」，夥拍對美食素有要求的譚玉瑛，每集帶大家搜購心水食材，並由鼎爺親自下廚，炮製多道拿手小菜、湯水及甜品，為大家奉上懷舊粵菜好滋味！如何以「抵食價」煮出正宗古法鹽焗雞的味道？怎樣掌控蒸魚的火候和時間？秋冬時份，不少人愛吃「香噴噴」煲仔飯，更不會錯過香脆的飯焦，但大家又可曾見過有兩面飯焦的煲仔飯？且看鼎爺大顯身手，一一教路！

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 397
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 在你的冬夜里闪耀 / Winter Night Episode 23
programme.desc:
在城市漂泊惨遭爱情事业双重打击的社畜郑达前(乔欣饰)，否极泰来得到东北老家拆迁款，踏上了返乡之行。火流星引发的磁暴，火车在旷野中滞留。目睹了火流星的郑达前没想到时空就此发生错乱，她来到了平行时空！
在这她见到了死去的父亲，未曾离婚远走的母亲，儿时的玩伴、错过的初恋慕子李(马思超饰)！无法返回原世界的郑达前，抓住这次机会，将以前的遗憾一一弥补，而她与慕子李过去的一段朦胧恋情，真爱的种子也随春的到来萌发了。可惜火流星再度出现，郑达前和慕子李即将成为被分割两个世界触不到的恋人……！

programme.desc: 由资深新闻工作者负责的《世界观》，带你用世界观、观世界，更阔更广看新闻、长知识。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 397
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 20
programme.desc: 第二十集 高哲與非原居民代表康年見面，對方似與傲堂有私人恩怨。依寧給敬賢帶來天生的黑材料，但敬賢選擇親自訪問天生。天生被詹兆齊出賣令競選商會主席失敗，懷恨在心。程凱答應報告進度卻睡過頭，澤雨只好拿出尚未完善的智能家居1.0來匯報。程凱大發雷霆兄弟倆差點反目。天生勸海泉賣地不果，直斥海泉沒本事！

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 & 今日知多D / Mrs. RevengeWhat's On Today Episode 7
programme.desc: 善良的幸如(高海宁饰)，活于丈夫施继威(张颕康饰)的压榨下，罹患绝症。她撞破丈夫与唯一闺蜜潘雪文(郭柏妍饰)的奸情，争执间被推出马路惨遭车撞。然而，幸如突然醒来，发现一切似乎只是场梦。但当梦中场景接连应验，她意识到这或是预知梦。为改写命运，幸如决心扭转梦中的悲剧。幸如不仅要摆脱渣男与假闺蜜，更设法撮合二人，让雪文「接手」其原本的不幸。她又善用梦境记忆、换上亮丽外型，在职场力争上游，还和并肩作战的上司叶家谦(马国明饰)渐生情愫，最终开拓幸福人生！

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 2
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 223
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 重症解密 / Severe Case Decoded Episode 12
programme.desc: 节目锁定不同重症，以深入浅出的方式道出顽疾成因、病理机制、最新治疗方案和预防方法。谭俊彦、陈晓华、林秀怡、梁凯晴化身「重症调查科」调查员，四出搜罗线索、证物、证人，务求解开各种致命危疾的重重疑团。来自香港各大公立与私家医院，及本地大学医学院的资深医生与学者，结合真实病例、医疗影像，令复杂的医学知识变得贴地，让大众更全面认知重症的诊治过程，减少误解与恐惧，也鼓励港人及早检查、及时治疗，守护健康未来。

programme.title: 在你的冬夜里闪耀 / Winter Night Episode 23
programme.desc:
在城市漂泊惨遭爱情事业双重打击的社畜郑达前(乔欣饰)，否极泰来得到东北老家拆迁款，踏上了返乡之行。火流星引发的磁暴，火车在旷野中滞留。目睹了火流星的郑达前没想到时空就此发生错乱，她来到了平行时空！
在这她见到了死去的父亲，未曾离婚远走的母亲，儿时的玩伴、错过的初恋慕子李(马思超饰)！无法返回原世界的郑达前，抓住这次机会，将以前的遗憾一一弥补，而她与慕子李过去的一段朦胧恋情，真爱的种子也随春的到来萌发了。可惜火流星再度出现，郑达前和慕子李即将成为被分割两个世界触不到的恋人……！

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 160
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 96
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 呃钱 / Scam Alert! Episode 8
programme.desc: 各类骗案数字持续上升，涉及的款项亦甚夸张。据悉香港每日平均损失达2500万元，每13分钟就有一宗骗案发生……网购、求职、投资、交友应用程序、电话骗案等行骗招数越来越高明，市民要及时提高防骗意识，慎防中伏！主持区永权、萧正楠、李旻芳、梁敏巧网罗不同真实个案，深入了解事主被骗经过，节目还会以故事形式重现个中情节。专家们现身拆解不同犯案手法，协助观众辨识《呃钱》陷阱，避免成为骗徒目标！

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 223
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港早晨 及 世界观 / Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 21
programme.desc: 第二十一集 屈奇頓有一地皮可安置非原居民，天生利用兆齊向學禮洽購，被學禮識穿。程凱找到能提升智能家居效能的新晶片，澤雨因成本及交貨期問題有所保留，兄弟反目。高哲得知思妤有意和別的男子交往，妒忌卻無能為力。定垚偶遇澤雨，二人感觸物是人非。是夜，定垚與高哲同為有緣無份而傷感，引起定垚對高哲往事的好奇。明晞與海泉就原居民賠償金額發生拗撓，海泉突然暈倒！啟堂突然回港，定垚發現他做過手術。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 2
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 211
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.desc: 节目锁定不同重症，以深入浅出的方式道出顽疾成因、病理机制、最新治疗方案和预防方法。谭俊彦、陈晓华、林秀怡、梁凯晴化身「重症调查科」调查员，四出搜罗线索、证物、证人，务求解开各种致命危疾的重重疑团。来自香港各大公立与私家医院，及本地大学医学院的资深医生与学者，结合真实病例、医疗影像，令复杂的医学知识变得贴地，让大众更全面认知重症的诊治过程，减少误解与恐惧，也鼓励港人及早检查、及时治疗，守护健康未来。

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express Episode 165
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。

programme.title: 万福金安 & 今日知多D / Wan Fu Jin An & What's On Today Episode 6
programme.desc: 皇后顾清（王艺瑾 饰）遭人陷害，命丧一场精心布局的大火，却意外重生到尚衣局婢女凤卿（方瑾 饰）身上。从高高在上的皇后变成身份卑微的宫女，凤卿没有被悲痛击倒，为了保护妹妹顾婉（吴曼思 饰），亦为查出自己遇害真相、揪出幕后真凶，她决定暂时隐藏锋芒，以凤卿身份在深宫中低调蛰伏。 凤卿深知单靠一己之力难以翻案，于是暗中联络身为太医的弟弟顾玹（储子竣 饰）。姐弟二人默契十足，连手在后宫各方势力之间周旋，一边避开重重刁难与陷阱，一边搜集线索，与宫中奸佞斗智斗力。 在这场复仇与守护交织的博弈中，凤卿与帝王萧骆（赵华为 饰）再度产生交集。萧骆一直对顾清的「惨死」心存疑窦，更隐约觉得凤卿身上有顾清的影子，因此不断试探她。凤卿面对萧骆亦是百感交集，二人在一次又一次交锋与拉扯之间，逐步解开昔日误会，前世未了的羁绊亦悄然延续。

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 7
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 自然系女子旅行 / The Joy Of Nature Episode 15
programme.desc: 第15集 陽明山溫泉豪華露營 映暉、上晏返回台北，到陽明山露營、浸溫泉！營區有一望無際的景觀，可俯瞰台北市的「百萬夜景」。豪華「神殿帳」設備齊全，還有暖氣及加熱床舖的先進裝置，十分貼心。營區提供射擊、足球等小遊戲，還可找職員一起玩「驚爆炸彈」等集體遊戲，映暉又成輸家，要接受什麼懲罰？餐廳的自助晚餐及早餐美食多不勝數，還可嚐到陽明山有名的手工饅頭！重頭戲當然是浸溫泉，二人看著窗外美景、浸在「牛奶」般的白磺泉中，美肌之餘疲勞盡消！

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 398
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 在你的冬夜里闪耀 / Winter Night Episode 24
programme.desc:
在城市漂泊惨遭爱情事业双重打击的社畜郑达前(乔欣饰)，否极泰来得到东北老家拆迁款，踏上了返乡之行。火流星引发的磁暴，火车在旷野中滞留。目睹了火流星的郑达前没想到时空就此发生错乱，她来到了平行时空！
在这她见到了死去的父亲，未曾离婚远走的母亲，儿时的玩伴、错过的初恋慕子李(马思超饰)！无法返回原世界的郑达前，抓住这次机会，将以前的遗憾一一弥补，而她与慕子李过去的一段朦胧恋情，真爱的种子也随春的到来萌发了。可惜火流星再度出现，郑达前和慕子李即将成为被分割两个世界触不到的恋人……！

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导& 世界观 & 今日知多D / News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 224
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 3
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 / Mrs. Revenge Episode 8
programme.desc: 善良的幸如(高海宁饰)，活于丈夫施继威(张颕康饰)的压榨下，罹患绝症。她撞破丈夫与唯一闺蜜潘雪文(郭柏妍饰)的奸情，争执间被推出马路惨遭车撞。然而，幸如突然醒来，发现一切似乎只是场梦。但当梦中场景接连应验，她意识到这或是预知梦。为改写命运，幸如决心扭转梦中的悲剧。幸如不仅要摆脱渣男与假闺蜜，更设法撮合二人，让雪文「接手」其原本的不幸。她又善用梦境记忆、换上亮丽外型，在职场力争上游，还和并肩作战的上司叶家谦(马国明饰)渐生情愫，最终开拓幸福人生！

programme.title: 万福金安 & 今日知多D / Wan Fu Jin An & What's On Today Episode 7
programme.desc: 皇后顾清（王艺瑾 饰）遭人陷害，命丧一场精心布局的大火，却意外重生到尚衣局婢女凤卿（方瑾 饰）身上。从高高在上的皇后变成身份卑微的宫女，凤卿没有被悲痛击倒，为了保护妹妹顾婉（吴曼思 饰），亦为查出自己遇害真相、揪出幕后真凶，她决定暂时隐藏锋芒，以凤卿身份在深宫中低调蛰伏。 凤卿深知单靠一己之力难以翻案，于是暗中联络身为太医的弟弟顾玹（储子竣 饰）。姐弟二人默契十足，连手在后宫各方势力之间周旋，一边避开重重刁难与陷阱，一边搜集线索，与宫中奸佞斗智斗力。 在这场复仇与守护交织的博弈中，凤卿与帝王萧骆（赵华为 饰）再度产生交集。萧骆一直对顾清的「惨死」心存疑窦，更隐约觉得凤卿身上有顾清的影子，因此不断试探她。凤卿面对萧骆亦是百感交集，二人在一次又一次交锋与拉扯之间，逐步解开昔日误会，前世未了的羁绊亦悄然延续。

programme.title: 重症解密 / Severe Case Decoded Episode 13
programme.desc: 节目锁定不同重症，以深入浅出的方式道出顽疾成因、病理机制、最新治疗方案和预防方法。谭俊彦、陈晓华、林秀怡、梁凯晴化身「重症调查科」调查员，四出搜罗线索、证物、证人，务求解开各种致命危疾的重重疑团。来自香港各大公立与私家医院，及本地大学医学院的资深医生与学者，结合真实病例、医疗影像，令复杂的医学知识变得贴地，让大众更全面认知重症的诊治过程，减少误解与恐惧，也鼓励港人及早检查、及时治疗，守护健康未来。

programme.title: 娱乐头条 / EXTRA Episode 800
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态、剧集和电影宣传、演唱会精华、颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事、追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌、影、视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息。

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 世界观 / Global View
programme.desc: 由资深新闻工作者负责的《世界观》，带你用世界观、观世界，更阔更广看新闻、长知识。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 21
programme.desc: 第二十一集 屈奇頓有一地皮可安置非原居民，天生利用兆齊向學禮洽購，被學禮識穿。程凱找到能提升智能家居效能的新晶片，澤雨因成本及交貨期問題有所保留，兄弟反目。高哲得知思妤有意和別的男子交往，妒忌卻無能為力。定垚偶遇澤雨，二人感觸物是人非。是夜，定垚與高哲同為有緣無份而傷感，引起定垚對高哲往事的好奇。明晞與海泉就原居民賠償金額發生拗撓，海泉突然暈倒！啟堂突然回港，定垚發現他做過手術。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 161
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 97
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？
